case.summary: Case HHG-002 covers a online $292.36 transaction 3478782 on card C11891-K1 raised by a risk_score trigger. Graph investigation found 3 corroborating signal(s) - amount outlier, 48h burst, prior fraud on this card. Pattern assessed as card not present fraud; fraud probability 0.58 before additional evidence and 0.78 after, giving a verdict of fraud. Exposure across 1 transaction(s) is $292.36. Independent graph signals corroborate the finding, so the actions below follow from the policy routes shown with each one.
